High-level next steps from Redwood procurement/finance:

- Finance (Marissa) will confirm invoice upload method (AP portal vs email) and whether ACH info is sufficient for electronic payments.
- I'll own the mutual action plan and can draft a short PO/invoice mapping doc for Hendrix to review.

We typically run Net 45 for new vendors pending vendor-code enrollment and PO verification. That said, we do have an early-pay program (Automated Early Pay) for select partners that can move some invoices to Net 30 for a small discount. To evaluate Hendrix for that program we need:
1) Completed onboarding form (received)
2) Remit bank details + CFR (or proof of bank account)
3) A sample of 2 recent invoices mapped to our PO formatting

Can you send the sample invoices and preferred remit instructions? I can then loop Karthik and Marissa with a proposed early-pay pilot: e.g., pilot 30% of monthly spend moved to Net 30/15% early pay discount window (we can be flexible on discount — we'll propose options).

Hi all — looping in procurement details.

Karthik here (procurement). A couple of clarifications and asks from our side:
- Vendor class: please indicate if Hendrix is a hardware supplier, services, or software reseller (helps with tax code mapping) — Maya, can you confirm on the form?
- PO placement: Redwood POs require the PO number in the invoice header and the line-item SKU mapping. If invoice samples include PO#: we can fast-track matching.
- ACH remit: we require a bank letter or voided check in addition to the bank routing/account fields.

Regarding payment terms: our standard enrollment for new vendors is Net 45 while we validate tax/class info and run the vendor through our payables controls. For an early-pay pilot I propose:
- Pilot period: 90 days
- Volume band: invoices up to $50k each; up to 30% of monthly spend eligible
- Terms: Net 30 with an early-pay discount schedule: 0.5% if paid by day 15, 0.25% if paid day 16–30.

If Hendrix agrees to the pilot conditions and provides the bank verification, we can onboard to Net 30 for the pilot group after procurement and finance sign-off. Otherwise we will start on Net 45 standard and revisit after 60 days.

Action items for Maya: please upload two invoice samples and a bank verification doc. I'll attach a short PO/invoice guidance doc for Hendrix (see attachment).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Manager, Procurement
